entries.note: SeedAsync performs three sequential SaveChangesAsync calls (brands, types, items) on one context; LC039 correctly identifies the repeated-save shape. Batching is a deliberate product decision for staged seeding, so the diagnostic is acknowledged rather than acted on.

TrySeedAsync enumerates roleManager.Roles and userManager.Users synchronously with .All(...) and calls context.TodoLists.Any() inside an async method; LC008 correctly flags the sync database round trips that have async counterparts.
